_readme: Shape metadata. Each entry pairs with an SVG in this folder. Draw at ANY size in ANY viewBox — the compiler measures the artwork, scales it uniformly into the 100 × 140 design sheet, and stands it on a shared ground line. <path> is native; rect/circle/ellipse/polygon/polyline are converted; <line> is skipped (no area to fill). Add or edit shapes here, then: npm run shapes:compile (or shapes:watch). npm run shapes:preview renders a PNG contact sheet with no browser. Order here = order in the picker within each category.
